## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: 3 runs, 1-112 to 1-114; 1-113 and 1-114 repeat D 6, d 1, V_H 6.15. D 6 and D_r 0 in every run; gamma differs by run. Soil No. 1 over Figs. 4-6a to 4-6c: 67 runs numbered up to 1-114, 47 numbers absent. Bed density control for the RS drag runs in F2-60 (b68-dens-f2-60-s01 to s04). Missing: fill depth of each bed and runs per bed, footpad dimensions beyond D, whether the pad pivot was free or locked, how the pad was brought to depth d, A_ft and A_pt values, how gamma was set per run while D_r stays 0, gravity (Earth inferred).
- Codex: 3 runs, 1-112 to 1-114. Table D_r constant. After the switch to vacuum handling. Exact pad profile and run-specific fill depth unreported.
